challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: We are stuck in a stalemate between {reliability_ruth.first} and {automation_alex.first} over the shadow run, but I am willing to make a concession to unblock the deployment. I accept that the canary testing setup remains absent for this cycle. In exchange, I require that the serving endpoint for the live forecast be fully automated. If the endpoint is not automated, I will not sign off on the new model, regardless of the shadow run results. This trade allows us to ship the promotion allocation logic while we still lack the canary infrastructure, prioritizing the immediate business need over long term testing rigor.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly accepts losing the canary testing setup for this cycle in exchange for full automation of the serving endpoint, stating a willingness to give up one requirement to satisfy another.
